HPIV-3 infectious embryofetopathy; the supplied definition establishes infection but provides no evidence of a consistently damaged organ.

Steroid-related borderline glaucoma/ocular hypertension is an eye condition; treatment causation does not change the affected organ of this named disease.

Skeletal muscle dystrophinopathy; intrinsic cardiomyopathy develops in roughly 50-70%; myoglobinuria and elevated transaminases reflect muscle injury.
Complex spastic paraplegia; retinal degeneration in 3/7 (~43%). Bladder dysfunction is neurologic, without established direct urinary-tract injury.
Inherited Alzheimer disease causes progressive cerebral neurodegeneration and dementia.
CNPY3 developmental epileptic encephalopathy with seizures, profound developmental impairment and brain atrophy; spasticity is neurologic.
Childhood neoplasm arising in or occupying the brain stem.
Trisomy/tetrasomy 12p syndromes typically cause developmental delay and intellectual disability; structural organ abnormalities vary across the umbrella.
Broad disorder of the lymphatic component of the immune system; subtype mechanisms and additional organ damage vary, preventing narrower generalization.
